managed-instance.title: What is Azure SQL Managed Instance?

facts.note: Sold under Microsoft licences per core or per server plus client access licences.
These are the editions the SQL Server 2025 lifecycle covers.
Can be installed on your own machines, virtual machines or containers.
Microsoft hosts it as Azure SQL Managed Instance, which is close to but not fully identical to SQL Server.
Newest major version and the end of its extended support; mainstream support ends 2031-01-07, and cumulative updates are released on top of it.
